2026_01_GB_MIN.headline: Green Bay and Minnesota open with healthy rosters and little room for wasted possessions
2026_01_GB_MIN.paragraph1: Minnesota enters the opener without an injury designation on its 53-man roster, while Green Bay arrives with a divisional road test that has often been decided by one possession. The Vikings can lean on a clean personnel picture and home-field communication; the Packers need Jordan Love to stay efficient against a defense that can disguise pressure and coverage. With both teams capable of sustaining drives, hidden-yardage mistakes, red-zone execution and protection against simulated pressure could matter more than raw play volume.
2026_01_GB_MIN.model_rationale: This matchup offers fewer obvious injury edges, so quarterback efficiency, red-zone execution and protection discipline become the clearest separators in a familiar divisional setting.
